reviews.text:
I took my dog Benito to get a health certificate for our trip back to the United States, and the whole process went smoothly! We made our appointment over the phone and arrived without any issues. The staff was incredibly kind and welcoming, and the veterinarian was one of the best we’ve ever visited. She was very knowledgeable, professional, and you can truly see how much she loves what she does.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for excellent veterinary care. If I could, I would give them six stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We have an immunocompromised kitty who has had bad experiences with other vets—but Dra. Hidalgo is absolutely amazing with our baby: her approach, techniques, and bedside manner with our cat are the best we’ve found. So thankful we found her after many uncaring veterinarians!
The best vet out here, super kind, reasonable, and trustworthy. Came here for a screwworm cert to travel with my dog and will definitely be coming back for any future things I need!

I am writing this in English to hopefully encourage other visitors to CDMX to find comfort in this vet office 😊 While visiting my 18 year old Chihuahua started to show signs of a tooth infection. After seeing another local vet it was clear my Spanish was not fluent enough to make me feel comfortable that I was understanding everything. Dr Hildago was a god send! She is kind and patient (my Chihuahua is not easy lol). She got to the root cause of his blood work and he is now being properly treated for Cushing's disease. I am truly grateful for her and her staff. We fly back to Europe in a couple of weeks and her staff will handle all of the health certificate paperwork for him as well. Don't hesitate! You and your fur babies are in great hands 💗
Excellent, they offer fear-free service.

This has been my vet for 6 years. Caro & Miroslava are experienced and knowledgeable professionals that are able to give evidence- and research-based services and accommodate any schedule or need. Appointments are easy to schedule online, the staff is bilingual and friendly, and it's the best quality-cost service one experienced. My two cats arrived here from the USA as rescues with trauma from their previous owners, as well as previous veterinary visits and procedures and were weary on their first visit to PetPoint. But afterwards, they comfortably roam the exam room and sit in the office chair. We will be off to Germany to live soon and we will dearly miss PetPoint.

Hello, YourGuide. We're sorry to hear your experience wasn't satisfactory.

We'd like to learn a little more about what happened so we can review your rating and, above all, identify if there's anything in our service we can improve. Based on the name under which the review was posted, we haven't been able to identify any specific service request or record that would allow us to follow up on your experience.

We invite you to write to us at petpointfrontera@gmail.com, sharing a little more information about your visit. We'll gladly review your case directly and respectfully.

At PetPoint, every comment is an opportunity to improve and offer a better experience to our families and patients. 🐾

I'm so happy I took my dog ​​to see Dr. Caro. Thanks to the nutritionist, Ale, I wish all veterinarians would learn from her the most important thing: how to treat dogs and, by extension, us. Thank you, Doctor, for your professionalism and love for your work. My dog ​​stopped trembling and was relaxed, something that NEVER happened with other veterinarians. I highly recommend her.

Thank you so much, Eduardo, for your 5-star rating! ⭐🐾
Your trust means so much to us. It's always a pleasure to welcome you and care for your pet. We're here for whatever you need! 💜 …

Thank you for your 5-star rating, Daniela! ⭐🐾
We truly appreciate your trust in us. We will continue working with all our love and professionalism to always provide you with the best care. 💜✨ …
The vet's service was awful! It took them three days to give me information she said she'd send in the afternoon, which was just about calculating the food I should give my overweight dog!

Hello, Alejandro.

We're sorry to hear your experience wasn't satisfactory. We'd love to hear what happened and have the opportunity to review it, as it's very important to us to offer quality service and appropriate care to each patient and their family.

If you'd like, you can email us at petpointfrontera@gmail.com with more details about your visit. We'll gladly follow up directly. 🐾
Excellent choice, full of professionalism

Pepper and Deimond from Cancun are thrilled with their experience at Pet Point. Dr. Caro is the best! She's saved my Boxer Deimond in every way possible since he was 2 months old, and Pepper is super healthy and loves going there for grooming.
Excellent vet! They always treat Martina so well and it puts my mind at ease. The bath is excellent!

I take my dog, La Güera, to Pet Point regularly, and the experience is always excellent. The service is top-notch: the team is incredibly professional, patient, and caring, and it's clear they genuinely care about the pets' well-being. From the moment we arrive, they treat her calmly and with great care, which gives me a lot of confidence. They also explain everything clearly and make you feel supported on every visit.
Without a doubt, this is a veterinary clinic I highly recommend for its outstanding service and compassionate approach.

An excellent choice for my pets. The highly trained doctors provide clear information and take their time to examine your pets. The grooming service is also top-notch. Without a doubt, the best option for pet care.

Horrible service at this clinic. The receptionists are rude, the veterinarian is very arrogant, and no one said the dog needed a microchip! The questionnaire didn't mention that a microchip was required, and they wasted our time. She told us to read the CDC guidelines, but they're the ones who should inform us before we arrive. I'm a doctor, and obviously I inform my patients about all the requirements before they come for their appointments. Or is it because we're not foreigners that they don't treat us well? Carolina Hidalgo is a terrible veterinarian, a horrible professional. On top of that, you write to them to tell them they denied you the certificate because of their clinic's policies, not Mexican law, but they don't understand and block you (less than professional).

We sincerely appreciate you taking the time to evaluate us, even without leaving a comment. Every visit and every opinion means a lot to us. We will continue working with the same commitment, ethics, and care to always offer the best medical and humane care to our patients and their families.

Thank you for trusting Pet Point 🐾💙
A super professional veterinarian, excellent service, very friendly, very good prices. The doctor is authorized to provide screwworm vaccination documents if you need to travel.

Thank you so much, Edgar, for your five-star rating! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We truly appreciate your trust in Pet Point. It's our pleasure to care for your pets and always provide you with the best service. 🐾💙 …

We had an excellent experience with this veterinarian. They took great care of our dog in preparation for our return trip to Europe and made the whole process smooth and stress-free. They were patient, thorough, and ensured that every requirement for travel was handled correctly.

We especially appreciated how they took the time to answer all our questions, explain the procedures, and reassure us throughout the visit. Our dog was treated with kindness and care, and we felt completely confident in their hands.

We highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a reliable and professional veterinarian — especially for international pet travel documentation.

We are very sorry to read your review. At Pet Point, we strive every day to offer a positive and personalized experience to each patient and their family. We couldn't find any visit record associated with your username, so we would appreciate it if you could share more information about your experience so we can review it in detail and offer you a solution.

Please email us at petpointfrontera@gmail.com with your visit details. Your feedback is very valuable in helping us continuously improve.

— Pet Point Team
Very friendly treatment of the dogs

I find it disrespectful that they make you fill out a super long form, only for the vet on duty to ask just three questions and guess at a diagnosis. If they're making me fill out all that information, it's to get a more accurate diagnosis. Besides, they have misleading advertising claiming they have ultrasound equipment and other procedures, when they don't; they're dependent on third parties. Furthermore, the fact that they're "fear-free" doesn't mean they're incompetent or incapable of even trimming a patient's nails. It's sad that they open veterinary clinics for profit and not out of a duty to help animals, especially when you're paying 750 pesos for 20 wasted minutes.

I was looking for a vet to give my dog ​​a dental checkup. I was worried about the anesthesia since she's older. We went for a consultation, and they explained the procedure to me. They also use inhaled anesthesia. Everything went perfectly with Luna. They contacted me after her checkup and also to ask me before performing any extractions. They are definitely qualified veterinarians with a human touch. They also have very competitive prices for the area.
It's clear that all the staff love animals. Luna left happy and calm.
Thank you so much, Pet Point!

I’ve taken Onyx to many vet clinics across the USA & Latin America.

Pet point is by far the best we’ve been to.
Lorena was very helpful to via text & over the phone.

Dra. Carolina was amazing & insightful.

We needed a last minute travel document (screw-worm) for Onyx, they were able help me out & for a very reasonable price.

If you’re in Condesa/Roma Norte area. I highly recommend visiting Pet Point ))
My cat was vaccinated to prepare him for an upcoming trip. The veterinarians were very kind and explained everything professionally, answering all my questions. I'm traveling with peace of mind.

Huge thanks to Dr. Carolina at Pet Point in CDMX 🐾 She treated my little Chihuahua, Baxter, with so much care while getting him ready to fly back to the U.S. She handled all the certificates we needed, and her professionalism and kindness made the whole process stress-free. If you’re in Mexico City with your furry friend, I can’t recommend her enough! ❤️🐶
Thank you so much, Pamela! 💙 We really appreciate your 5-star rating and your trust. We hope to see you and your furry friend again soon! 🐾 …
My cat was prescribed and sold Leidof to calm her down on a flight, but THAT MEDICATION DOES NOT HAVE THAT FUNCTION.
Super sweet vet who was great with my very scared dog. Highly recommend, even though it is expensive.

I had a great experience and highly recommend this vet. I came in to get a screwworm certificate to travel to the US and the service was exceptional. It was so easy to schedule an appointment online, they sent all the necessary docs prior to the appointment, they were on time, professional and informative.

The entire staff loves animals and they all love their job, it shows through on every visit. They truly are, "Fear Free" certified and make each appointment as easy as possible for our pup. We are very fortunate to have been recommended to Pet Point and we recommend them to everyone who has a four-legged family member.

Thank you so much, Perla, for your 5-star rating! 🌟 We're so glad to hear you had a positive experience. We're always here for you and your furry friends, committed to providing the best care. Thank you for trusting us! 🐾✨ …

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! 🌟 We're so happy to know you had a positive experience. We work with love and dedication every day to provide the best possible care. Thank you for trusting us! 🐾✨ …

If only every city had a Dr. Carolina!! I'm absolutely blown away by the kindness and professionalism.

You can immediately tell that Dr. Carolina is extremely knowledgeable and passionate about animal care. She takes the time to explain everything and is extremely gentle with our otherwise cowardly little pup. Honestly, the only vet I've ever seen our dog not panic about.

The prices are fair and transparently posted online. Booking is also a breeze online.

** She is also one of the few government authorized vets that can give screwworm certificates - recently a necessity for USA travel!

Thank you 😊
Thank you for your rating! It means a lot to us and motivates us to continue providing the best care to our patients and their families. We hope to see you soon at Pet Point!

Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to hear that your experience at Pet Point was positive. We will continue working diligently to provide the best care for our patients. We hope to see you again soon!

“PRICES IN MEXICAN PESOS AND SUBJECT TO CHANGE WITHOUT PRIOR NOTICE” is their fine print and you will be blindsided by the total.

I was so excited and grateful to have found this place until I realized how overcharged I was. The reviews seemed great, but I booked for a travel document appointment to go from CDMX back to the U.S - it stated in my confirmation email and even under their “services” on their page/google tab that it is MX$450. I did add the screwworm certificate just in case on top of the normal health certificate since they’re having that problem in MX. When I go to check out my total says $1650MX? What?

I asked about the increase and how I was told $450, but I was reassured that that was just for “domestic” travel documents? International papers are higher. Extremely weird since I put in all my information and accurate countries. Language barrier wasn’t the issue - they speak English and my friend whose first language is Spanish was with me. No itemized paper was offered. I try to travel with morals, i.e. I don’t mind being charged a “tourist tax”, but this was extremely too much and so deceiving. To put this into perspective - I was charged more money than what an  X-ray or emergency vet visit would cost and only a few pesos off from what an ultrasound would cost here. FOR 2 PIECES OF PAPER? The swift physical exam didn’t even take her more than 2 minutes.

I’ve attached my bank account payment in USD$ to show the $1650+MX total and their price list of other, more intense services for you to compare.  Please see the attached photos and read the fine print.

“*PRECIOS EN PESOS MEXICANOS Y SUJETOS A CAMBIO SIN PREVIO AVISO
*PRICES IN MEXICAN PESOS AND SUBJECT TO CHANGE WITHOUT PRIOR NOTICE”
